To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Pennsylvania Right to Know Act, I hereby request the following records:

- The District Attorney's Office's current records retention and disposition policy or schedule, including any schedule adopted under the Municipal Records Act, 53 Pa.C.S. §§ 1381-1389
- Any policy, guidance, or directive governing the retention, deletion, or auto-deletion of employee emails, including any policy classifying emails as "transitory" or "non-records," in effect at any time since January 1, 2020
- Records sufficient to show the automatic deletion or purge settings applied to the Office's email system (including any setting that deletes emails after a set number of days), in effect at any time since January 1, 2020
- Any policy or procedure governing litigation holds or the preservation of emails when a Right-to-Know Law request, appeal, or lawsuit is pending, in effect at any time since January 1, 2020
- Any policy governing the use of text messages or ephemeral messaging apps for official business, in effect at any time since January 1, 2020

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the Right-to-Know Law requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
